investigation.title: Remote Agent Creation Blocked by Swarm Agent Quota Exhaustion (HTTP 409)
investigation.summary: The eval check `remote-agent-create` failed immediately with an HTTP 409 conflict because the production swarm backend rejected the POST /api/agents request with "agent quota exceeded: limit is 100". All three remote-agent checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) share the identical error message, confirming the failure originates at the agent creation step before any downstream state or runtime logic is reached.
investigation.rootCause: The production swarm backend is enforcing a hard agent quota limit of 100 for the eval probe's organization. When the eval runner called POST /api/agents (via `createAgent` in `infra/evals/status/run-status-probes.mjs` line 808), the swarm layer returned HTTP 409 with error code "conflict" and message "conflict: agent quota exceeded: limit is 100". Because agent creation is the first step shared by all three remote-agent checks, none of them could proceed, and all required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was left unrecorded. This is an eval infrastructure failure against the production API — no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so a user-facing outage cannot be confirmed from this packet alone.

A prior eval run, a leaked agent from a failed cleanup, or accumulated agents from repeated observability runs may have filled the quota, preventing new agent creation.

investigation.title: Image Generation Stream Eval Failure: SESSION_OPEN_FAILED (404) on production-api — Agent Runtime Harness Unreachable
investigation.summary: The image-generation-stream eval for the production-api runtime environment failed immediately (latencyMs=2069) with a SESSION_OPEN_FAILED error carrying HTTP 404, indicating the agent runtime harness endpoint targeted by the eval runner was not reachable at the time of the run. The identical check passed on the desktop-release sibling runtime (latencyMs=191483, all required evidence collected), confirming the underlying image generation capability is functional and the failure is isolated to the production-api harness endpoint configuration or deployment.
investigation.rootCause: The eval runner called /api/generate/image/stream via the production-api harness (resolved through LOCAL_HARNESS_URL or SWARM_BASE_URL) and received an HTTP 404 before any generation frames could be emitted. This caused a SESSION_OPEN_FAILED error that terminated the stream after only a generation_start frame, leaving both required evidence keys (frameTypes, imageUrlPresent) uncollected. The root cause is that the agent runtime harness endpoint is either not deployed, deployed at a different URL than the one configured for the production-api runtime environment, or running an incompatible version that does not expose the expected route. This is an eval infrastructure / harness connectivity failure, not a confirmed user-facing product outage; no user-traffic or incident signals are present in the evidence.

The root cause is that the agent runtime harness endpoint is either not deployed, deployed at a different URL than the one configured for the production-api runtime environment, or running an incompatible version that does not expose the expected route.
